description: A painting of a Black woman in a white head wrap and long dark shawl and dress stands on a wooden platform in a dim hall with a raised arm, speaking toward a seated audience. Lit wall candles, a wooden pulpit, arched windows and a beamed ceiling fill the room. The audience of men and women in dark 19th-century clothing sits on wooden pews, and the image fills the canvas edge to edge with no visible text.
